prompt: 幫城市 as-twn-kaohsiung-shape-rect（變體 orig）用 LLM 把規定路段收成該城指定的形狀，反覆 export -> 分析 -> apply 迭代到達成或收斂（上限 10 輪）。

transcript.note: Round 1, one batch for the whole ring. suggest's winding is counter-clockwise (shoelace +294) while the current ring is clockwise (-222), so applying it as a group would be a 180-degree reversal and get refused; I built my own side assignment with the current clockwise winding instead, keeping the existing box [1,13]x[1,13] (side 12 both ways, so four equal sides). Sides first, corners after: each ring station was assigned to the side it already sits nearest in ring order and snapped onto that side's line - south y=1: 11 (3,3)->(3,1), 6 (5,2)->(5,1), 7 stays (9,1); west x=1: 4 (0,5)->(1,5) (it was one column outside the box), 13 stays (1,10); north y=13: 3 stays (8,13); east x=13: 14 stays (13,4), 16 (11,8)->(13,8). Then the corners: 15 (2,12)->(1,13) and 0 (12,11)->(13,13) already turn naturally there, so they become the NW and NE corner stations and need no control point; the SE and SW corners have no station straddling them cleanly, so one corner control point each on genuinely adjacent pairs - (13,1) between 14 and 7, (1,1) between 11 and 4 - which holds control points to 2 and lets every other station just slide onto its nearest side. Interior hub 8 (6,9) and the outside branches (10, 12, 2, 5, 9, 1) are deliberately left in place: I checked the atan2 neighbour order around every degree>=3 vertex (8, 16, 4, 7, 3) and the cyclic order is unchanged under these targets, and no interior edge (4-8, 8-3, 8-7, 8-16) leaves the box, so nothing needs pushing aside and crossings should stay 0.
